sessionId.description: The session the event belongs to.

ts.description: Time the event was produced, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

BlobRef.description: A copy of a file's content kept by Core (ADR-0009 rule 8).

path.description: Absolute path of the copy, under Core's data directory.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the content, lowercase hex.

Capability.description:
A named optional protocol feature, for example `planMode`.

Capabilities are open strings rather than an enum: a peer must accept capability names
it does not know, because that is how newer minor versions announce additions.

connectionEpoch.description:
Incremented every time Core (re)starts an Agent Host for the workspace; lets both
sides tell connections apart after a restart.

enabled.description: Capabilities enabled for this connection: the intersection of both sides.

workspace.description: Absolute path of the workspace this Agent Host serves.

kind.description: What it names; symlinks are followed (a dangling one is `other`).

retryable.description: Whether repeating the same request could succeed.

oneOf.description: Invalid JSON or invalid UTF-8 was received.
The message is not a valid AHP JSON-RPC message (including batches).
The method does not exist or is not available.
The method parameters are invalid.
An unexpected internal failure.
The peers' major protocol versions differ.
A frame exceeded the receiver's size limit.

The receiver is shutting down and no longer accepts requests. Core API only: not
sent over AHP until a capability introduces it.

The receiver's queue is full; retrying later can succeed. Core API only: not sent
over AHP until a capability introduces it.

No response arrived within the request's timeout; whether the request took effect is
unknown.

The connection to the Agent Host ended before the request reached a final state; it
may or may not have taken effect, and it is not replayed. Core API only.
The Agent Host is not connected: it is starting, restarting or stopped. Core API only.
No open session has the given id.
The session is running a turn and cannot start another one yet.

The path named by a file operation does not exist. `details`: `{ code: "ENOENT",
path }`.

The path of a file or command operation resolves, after normalization and symlink
resolution, to a location outside the session's workspace root. `details`:
`{ path, resolved, root }`.

The operating system refused a file or process operation. `details`: `{ code, path }`
with a POSIX-style error code such as `EACCES`, `EISDIR` or `ENOTDIR`.

The credential vault exists but its master key is gone from the system credential
store. Nothing is created or overwritten; the user decides how to recover.

The system credential store refused access to the master key, is locked or cannot be
reached. Retryable once the user grants access. `details`: `{ reason }` with
`accessDenied`, `unavailable` or `failed`.
The credential vault failed authentication (modified or damaged); no entry is returned.

The credential vault has a format version this build does not know. `details`:
`{ version }`.
A `secrets/*` request named a lock that is no longer held (expired or released).

ErrorObject.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 error object with PiArc's mandatory structured `data`.

code.description: Error code; see [`code`] for the standard and application ranges.

message.description: Human-readable description. Not meant for branching.

ErrorResponse.description: An error response. It has `error` and must not have `result`.

id.description:
The id of the request being answered; `null` when it could not be determined (for
example a parse error). The member itself is required.

sessionId.description: The session that started the command.

killed.description: False when no such command was running (it already ended, or never started).

ExecOutputParams.description: Parameters of `exec/output` (Core → Agent Host): one chunk of a running command's output.

requestId.description: The `requestId` of the `exec/run` that started the command.

seq.description: 1, 2, 3, ... across both streams of the command, in the order Core read them.

stream.description: The stream the chunk came from.

cwd.description:
Working directory, absolute or relative to the session's; the session's when absent.
It must lie inside the workspace root.

env.description: Variables set on top of Core's environment for this command.

origin.description: The tool call this request serves.

requestId.description:
Chosen by the Agent Host, unique among its running commands; `exec/output` and
`exec/kill` refer to the command by it.

sessionId.description: The session whose workspace and working directory apply.

exitCode.description: The exit code, when the command exited normally.

signal.description: The terminating signal number on Unix, when a signal ended the command.

oneOf.description: A regular file.
A directory.
Anything else: a device, socket or pipe.

imageMimeType.description:
`image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/gif`, `image/webp` or `image/bmp` when
`detectImage` was set and the content is such an image.

modifiedMs.description: Last modification, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, when the platform reports it.

readonly.description: Whether the file has no write permission at all.

size.description: Size in bytes (0 for directories on some platforms).

exclude.description:
Glob patterns of paths to leave out, relative to the searched directory, for example
`**/node_modules/**`.

limit.description: Matches to return at most; Core caps it at 100,000.

origin.description: The tool call this request serves.

pattern.description:
Glob pattern. Without `/` it matches the file name at any depth; with `/` it matches
the path relative to the searched directory, as if prefixed with `**/`.

sessionId.description: The session whose workspace and working directory apply.

matches.description:
Matching files and directories relative to the searched directory, `/`-separated,
directories with a trailing `/`, in path order. Hidden entries are included; entries
ignored by `.gitignore`, `.ignore` or `exclude` are not.

path.description: The resolved path of the searched directory.

truncated.description: Whether the limit cut the matches short.

context.description: Lines of context before and after each match; 0 when absent.

glob.description: Only search files matching this glob, relative to the searched directory.

limit.description: Matches to return at most; 100 when absent.

origin.description: The tool call this request serves.

path.description: The directory or file to search.

pattern.description: Regular expression (ripgrep syntax), or a literal string with `literal`.

sessionId.description: The session whose workspace and working directory apply.

limitReached.description: Whether more matches exist beyond the limit.

lines.description: Matches and context lines, by file in path order, then by line.

path.description: The resolved path of the searched directory or file.

limit.description: Entries to return at most; Core caps it at 10,000.

origin.description: The tool call this request serves.

sessionId.description: The session whose workspace and working directory apply.

entries.description: Entries in file name order, dotfiles included.

path.description: The resolved path of the directory.

truncated.description: Whether the limit cut the listing short.

origin.description: The tool call this request serves.

path.description: The directory to create, with any missing parents.

sessionId.description: The session whose workspace and working directory apply.

created.description: False when the directory already existed.

length.description: Bytes to read at most (text mode); [`MAX_READ_CHUNK`] when absent or larger.

offset.description: First byte to read (text mode); 0 when absent.

origin.description: The tool call this request serves.

sessionId.description: The session whose workspace and working directory apply.

blob.description: The content's copy, in blob mode.

bytesRead.description:
Number of file bytes the content covers; the next range starts at `offset +
bytesRead`.

eof.description: Whether the content reaches the end of the file.

offset.description: The offset the content starts at.

size.description: Size of the file in bytes when it was opened.

detectImage.description: Also sniff the first bytes of a regular file for a supported image type.

origin.description: The tool call this request serves.

path.description: The path to inspect; symlinks are followed.

sessionId.description: The session whose workspace and working directory apply.

append.description: Append to the file instead of replacing it; false when absent.

content.description: Text to write, encoded as UTF-8.

origin.description: The tool call this request serves.

path.description: The file to write; its parent directory must exist.

sessionId.description: The session whose workspace and working directory apply.

GrepLine.description: One line of grep output: a match or a context line.

isMatch.description: Whether the line matches (false for context lines).

path.description:
The file: relative to the searched directory and `/`-separated, or the file name when
a single file was searched.

text.description: The line without its terminator; lines over 4,096 characters are cut there.

pi.description: Version of the Pi SDK the Agent Host runs.

protocol.description: Protocol version spoken by the Agent Host.

sentAt.description: Core's send time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, echoed in the result.

reason.description: Why Core asks the Agent Host to exit, for its log (for example `idle` or `appQuit`).

HostShutdownResult.description:
Result of `host/shutdown`, sent once every session is closed and before the process
exits.

closedSessions.description: Number of sessions that were closed.

HostStatus.description: Result of `host/ping`: liveness plus resource counters of the Agent Host.

outboundQueuedFrames.description: Frames waiting to be written to stdout right now.

rssBytes.description: Resident set size of the Agent Host process, in bytes.

An item in its current state, discriminated by the `type` member. Every variant

oneOf.description: Text produced by the agent.

oneOf.description: A tool call without a specialised item type.

arguments.description: The arguments the tool was called with.

itemId.description: The item's identifier: the tool call id.

output.description: The text the tool returned, in `item/completed`.

item.description: The item's state: `inProgress` when started, final when completed.

Standard error.

Any session notification, read without interpreting its method: header plus payload.
